office: the National Identification Agency (NIDA), through Irembo and the sector offices

routes.label: applied for on Irembo, biometrics at the sector office; ready in 30 days at the sector of residence

note: NIDA's page for a first issuance: the card is issued at 16; the applicant pays 500 francs on Irembo and has the biometrics taken at a sector office; the card is ready in 30 days at the sector of residence. A replacement costs 1,500 francs (not modelled). The card's term isn't on NIDA's pages, so it's null.

sources.title: National Identification Agency (Rwanda), Application for ID
sources.said: The Rwandan identity card is issued to a 16-year-old Rwandan, registered in NIDA database (NPR). ... If you want to get that service, please click here to pay 500Fr, start requesting an ID: ... IDs are completed in 30 days and are sent the sector of residence, where the applicant can go and recuperate his/her ID.

sources.title: National Identification Agency (Rwanda), FAQs
sources.said: The ID replacement costs 1500fr paid on Irembo
